name: personal-brand
description: Instagram carousel PNG and reel MP4 generators (system/ig-carousel, system/ig-reel): generic render engines fed by profiles/<slug>/.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit; pnpm --filter @personal-brand/editor-server run typecheck; pnpm --filter @personal-brand/editor-web run typecheck
scripts.test: tsx system/ig-carousel/verify-slides.test.ts && tsx system/ig-carousel/recipe.test.ts && tsx system/ig-carousel/layout-template.test.ts && tsx system/ig-carousel/carousel-document.test.ts && tsx system/ig-carousel/brand-style.test.ts && tsx system/ig-carousel/templates/free-layout.test.ts && tsx system/ig-reel/reel.test.ts && tsx system/assets/assets.test.ts && pnpm --filter @personal-brand/editor-server test
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
